description: Verifies the JPL HORIZONS interface: the request URL carries the target, centre and ephemeris type, and a vector table between the SOE and EOE markers is parsed into SI state vectors.

checks.label: the URL requests the Earth NAIF identifier 399
the URL requests the solar system barycentre as centre
the URL requests a vector table
the first epoch is the Julian date 2451545
the first x position is converted from kilometres to metres
the first x velocity is converted from kilometres per second to metres per second
the second epoch is the Julian date 2451546
the second x position is converted from kilometres to metres
